title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Disclosing Information Related to Civil and Commercial Cases
keywords_en: People's Court's regulations on public disclosure of civil and commercial cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Publicizing Information Related to Civil and Commercial Cases

Fa [2019] No. 36

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to implement the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening Judicial Transparency" and to further increase the transparency of information related to civil and commercial cases, thereby creating a more stable, fair, transparent, and predictable business environment, the following notice is hereby issued regarding the deepening of work related to judicial transparency:

I. Expanding the Scope of Judicial Transparency for Civil and Commercial Cases

Each High People's Court shall make full use of existing judicial transparency platforms or establish dedicated judicial transparency platforms to proactively disclose to the public information such as the average trial duration and case closure rate for civil and commercial cases at all levels of people's courts within its jurisdiction.

People's courts at all levels shall actively explore disclosing to the parties the expected trial duration for pending civil and commercial cases that have not been concluded within the trial time limit. Where it is difficult to determine a specific trial duration due to objective reasons beyond the court's control, disclosure may be temporarily postponed. After such objective reasons are eliminated, the information shall still be disclosed.

II. Grasping the Timing of Judicial Transparency for Civil and Commercial Cases

Information such as the average trial duration and case closure rate for civil and commercial cases shall, to the extent possible, be automatically captured and updated in real time through computer programs. For High People's Courts where conditions are not yet available, the minimum update frequency shall not be less than once per quarter.

The expected trial duration for pending civil and commercial cases shall, in principle, be disclosed from the date when the trial time limit expires. Where it is difficult to determine a specific trial duration due to objective reasons beyond the court's control, it shall be promptly disclosed and updated in real time from the date when such objective reasons are eliminated.

III. Implementing Specific Requirements for the Disclosure of Trial Procedure Information

The High People's Courts of Beijing and Shanghai shall ensure that this work is completed by mid-February 2019. Other High People's Courts shall complete this work as soon as possible based on local conditions, and no later than the end of 2019. Upon completion of the work, each High People's Court shall promptly report the situation to this Court.

February 3, 2019
